facts.fact: The Portfolio Committee on Communications and Digital Technologies of Parliament extended to 21 September 2026 the deadline for written submissions from the public, industry bodies and civil society organisations on the Electronic Communications Amendment Bill [B12-2026], and invited submitters to ask to make oral presentations; the extension was announced 2026-08-20.
